reviewMethod: Assistant visual inspection of start/motion/end captures and independently extracted video frames at 10, 14, 18 and 22 seconds. Title-only footage from the earlier attempt was rejected. These short interactions do not constitute full playtests or completion.

previews.visualReview: Title and transition are followed by the real first platforming room. Sampled frames show the character moving and attempting jumps around the snowy ledges. This is the free PICO-8 Classic, not commercial Celeste.

The Lani's Trek title transitions into the actual outdoor room. Extracted frames show changing character position and horizontal camera movement around the vehicle and snowy ledges. Clearly labelled as a library-captured public browser preview, not an official trailer.
